The '''Kroctar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Shataum sector/Legends|Shataum sector]] of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]]. The system contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kroctar]].
